name: Accendra Health, Inc.
business_overview: Accendra Health, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a healthcare solutions company in the United States. It offers a range of products and services for in-home care and delivery for diabetes treatment; home respiratory therapy, including home oxygen and non-invasive ventilation services; obstructive sleep apnea treatment, such as continuous positive airway pressure and bi-level positive airway pressure devices, and patient support services. The company also supplies other home medical equipment, patient care product lines including ostomy, wound care and negative pressure wound therapy, urology, incontinence, and other products and services. It serves patients and home health agencies. The company was formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc. and changed its name to Accendra Health, Inc. in December 2025. Accendra Health, Inc. was founded in 1882 and is based in Glen Allen, Virginia.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Provides home healthcare equipment and services primarily to patients and home health agencies in the US.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Accendra’s top line is under pressure from a lost payer relationship, but the core business is reaping the benefits of a recent separation from Owens & Minor, which has driven a sharp, immediate lift in gross profitability. The operationally leaner structure points to a healthier cost base, though the net-margin profile still lags industry peers, keeping the market cautious until top-line stability returns.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership executed the Owens & Minor split to unlock margin gains and then moved swiftly to refinance the balance sheet, securing a credit-outlook upgrade from S&P. Management is standing by its full-year guidance, signaling conviction that the cost restructuring will deliver a strong back-half EBITDA rebound despite the revenue headwind. The debt restructuring and maintained outlook reflect a credible effort to de‑risk the story, though the street waits for evidence of sustained commercial momentum.
